item.title: Boku no Hibi ~Kouen to Tonari Machi no Otoko no Ko Hen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mogura Tengu
  • 発売日: 2015-06-19
  • スコア: 6.63/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ボクの日々 ～公園と隣町の男の子編～
  • 英語名: Boku no Hibi Kouen to Tonari Machi no Otoko no Ko Hen

别名

  • Boku no Hibi‛： Local Boys and the Park

あらすじ

With his parents away on a business trip, Kazuki was sent live with his big breasted, all female family members of the “Teshigahara” household.

He came to enjoy his new day-to-day life with the Teshigahara house, and even made friends at school.
